words.gloss: those who have as their goal

literal: Wealth as their goal those who have, their base charm will not embrace, grace as wealth seeking those of wisdom.
translation: The wise who seek the higher wealth of grace will not embrace the base charms of women who care only for material wealth.
modern: அருளாகிய செல்வத்தை நாடும் அறிஞர்கள், பணத்தையே குறியாகக் கொண்ட விலைமகளிரின் அற்பமான இன்பத்தைத் தீண்ட மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts two types of wealth: material money and spiritual grace. Women who sell their affection care only for material wealth, offering a base and meaningless physical charm in return. Men of true wisdom, who seek the higher wealth of grace and compassion, recognize this emptiness and will never touch such superficial pleasures.
